I was driving home from the airport. I was tired, but feeling good from a productive daytrip across the state. I had my windows down, enjoying the 75 degree weather. I was listening to NPR, a staple of my evening commute since I moved to South Florida and had to buy a car (because public transportation down here sucks).

I was doing a lot of things.. and nothing simultaneously, as were the hundreds of motorists I'd already passed. Everyone had their own lives. Some had their windows down.. I could hear latin jazz coming from the speakers of a wildly colored BMW. Most people had their windows up - either habit from the summer months or they just didn't like the street noise.

Then I saw the guy up ahead.
